notes: dedup.group is exact-md5; variant_family is a curated table of same-design variants (VARIANT_FAMILIES in bench/manifest.py).
java.class comes from java_source.results — regenerate after the -mp 9999 re-baseline (ROADMAP M0.5) or the classes go stale.
stability.class is the G2.1 gate selector: only java_finished + stable is judged comparatively, everything else (unstable, no_result, unmeasured) gets the absolute gate.
stability.unrouted/violations are Java's self-reported numbers, not the referee's, and are comparable only with each other and with stability.started_unrouted — never with a referee count.
snap_angle_effective falls back to the reader default (fortyfive_degree) when the board declares none.
uncapped.uncapped_wall_s is T_java(complete) ONLY when uncapped.status == 'completed'; 'hit_cap' is a lower bound and 'blocked' measures a modal-dialog hang, not the board.
the uncapped campaign ran with the fanout stage inactive while java_source.results ran it on 37/46 boards — the two Java columns are not the same pipeline (measurement-campaign.md §5).
